title: Health checks — one record per production check run
note: One record per RUN of the health watch (card CP-25 (health watch)), filed by the APP (review-app, through its records door) — the ONE named exception to the 2026-09-23 one-writer rule (decision log 2026-09-27). Append-only: a new file per run, never an edit. Runs 20 minutes after each ai-dev production deploy, daily at 23:00Z, and on demand. Each record carries every signal's value, pass/fail, the window and the deploy sha; a failing signal ALSO files one `tasks` record per signature (dedupe and auto-close on the task, never here). Item id = the run's trigger + timestamp. The health view (card 2, design mock first) reads this kind.

verdict_fields.note: list of {name, value, threshold, pass, window, sample} — thresholds are data in the watch's own config file
the ai-dev production commit the run judged; required for post-deploy
the task ids this run filed or commented on
